name: Sales Playbook Section
description: Produces one section of a sales playbook with talk tracks, common scenarios, competitive differentiation, and handling guidance using playbook format methodology. Use when the user asks to create a sales playbook section, write a talk track for a specific sales scenario, build competitive battle cards, document a sales play, or structure guidance for a specific selling situation. Do NOT use for full objection handling banks (use objection-handling), discovery call scripts (use discovery-call-script), or sales training curriculum (use teaching skills).
